variationNeedsBoth: A variation needs both a start image and how much to change it
cannotStartFromImage: {label} can't start from an image; pick another model or remove the start image
faceLockNeedsBoth: A face lock needs both a face image and its strength
cannotLockFace: {label} can't lock a face; use one of: {able}
sizeRange: width and height must be multiples of {step} between {min_side} and {max_side}
sfwPrompt: {name}'s face is an uploaded photo, so images of {name} must be safe for work. Remove “{word}” from the prompt.
sfwStartImage: {name}'s face is an uploaded photo, so a variation of a sensitive image can't be made for {name}.
sfwCheckNotReady: The image check is still starting, and images of a character with an uploaded face can't be saved without it. Try again in a moment.
sfwDiscarded: The image of {name} came out with nudity, so it was discarded. Images of a character with an uploaded face are kept safe for work.
badPhoto: The face photo could not be read; use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image
missingCoverImage: The cover image is not in History
missingFaceImage: The face image is not in History
oneFace: Choose a face image from History or upload a photo, not both
duplicateName: There is already a character called {name}
cropOutside: The crop goes outside the {width}×{height} image
lastMessageFromUser: the last message must be from the user
modelServerDown: The model server is not running. Start it with: uv run python backend/model_server.py
modelServerSlow: The model server took too long. A first-time model download may still be running.
modelServerFailed: The model server failed ({status}). Check its terminal for details.
startImageGone: The start image is no longer in History; remove it and try again
characterGone: That character no longer exists; pick another one and try again
noUploadedFace: This character has no uploaded face
chatUnavailable: Chat is unavailable: set XAI_API_KEY in .env
startImageUnreadable: The start image could not be read
faceImageUnreadable: The face image could not be read
faceLockNoSpace: The face lock needs {gb} GB of free disk space for its one-time download.
faceLockDownloading: Downloading the face lock files once ({done} of {total} GB). Try again when it finishes.
modelDownloading: {label} is still downloading. Try again when the model list shows it is ready.
modelNotDownloaded: {label} is not downloaded. Download it from the model list first.
notEnoughSpace: Not enough disk space: free about {gb} GB more, then try again.
removeWhileDownloading: {label} is downloading; remove it when the download has finished.
noSuchJob: No such job; it may have finished
needsHfToken: {label} is gated on Hugging Face: accept its licence on the model page, then add HF_TOKEN=<your token> to .env and restart the model server.
needsCivitaiToken: {label} is downloaded from Civitai, which needs an API key: create one under Account settings → API Keys on civitai.com, add CIVITAI_TOKEN=<your key> to .env and restart the model server.
addonTwice: Each add-on can be switched on only once.
